title: Mucilaginous
summary: MUCILAG'INOUS, adjective Pertaining to or secreting mucilage; as the mucilaginous glands. 1. Slimy; ropy; moist, soft and lubricous; partaking of the nature of mucilage; as a mucilaginous gum.
